purpose: Preserve nonfatal A runtime stalls and the actual slow B command, without changing input authority, ordering, deadlines, retries or native submission count.

runtime.histograms: Known GC total, GC stopping or runnable observations in aggregate bucket 4/5. Rounded buckets do not prove exact durations.
runtime.failureBudget: Independent and unchanged; nonfatal observations never call ObserveFailure, change health or start runtime tracing.
runtime.privacy: Fixed numeric windows and whitelisted observation reasons. No stacks, input values, coordinates or identity data. Existing bounded export and sanitizer apply.

input.selection: Every tracked installed receiver command until the time/count limit; no heartbeat, maintenance or untracked commands. This is a total-window cap, not a per-second rate limiter.
input.rolling: Freeze old attempts before resetting the timing count. Owner/cursor lifetime limits remain unchanged.
input.retention: Existing first/worst profiles only; no per-command log and no extra round trip.
input.limits: Detail is still unavailable outside a tracked window, after its count cap, or when an ACK is lost. This does not guarantee every future tail is retained.

codecBenchmark.scope: One ACK encode/decode, 200ms benchmark per variant. Excludes native timing reads, context/profile copies, real pipes, processes and Windows scheduling. Not a physical latency result.

newG514Recurrence.health: Both services and protected input READY, but A connection FAULTED. This is later than the previous 14:57Z snapshot, not evidence that its coverage was fault-free indefinitely.
newG514Recurrence.A: 15:13:05Z source-hook failure has a 1366.549ms sampling interval, 1267.104ms timer lateness and >1s GC total/stopping observations. 15:43:48Z source-service-query-deadline-checking precedes source-hook failure and guard-close timeout; the GC trail includes a 1495.732ms interval with >1s total/stopping observations.
newG514Recurrence.scope: The association supports local GC world-stopping delay rather than proving heap-scanning work or a particular blocked Windows thread. Do not add independent histogram durations together. g515 improves evidence and does not claim this runtime defect fixed.

validation: GC observation boundary/cooldown/budget/privacy/export tests; actual 209ms third-command tail with native and ACK-read detail; cap and rolling tests; complete handoff/inputworker/productlog suites; resident runtime tests; go vet and diff checks.
deployment: Build/install/connection receipts recorded separately. No push or public release requested.
